title: SUPPRESSION COUNTS A ROUND ONCE
why: The cloud review found that the suppression count was wrong: two rounds flying near a pillager took turns and each was counted again every frame, so a short burst pinned him at once, and one shotgun blast (six pellets, four needed) pinned him by itself. Each round now counts once for each man, and a blast of pellets counts as one round, so the Support MG still pins a man in about half a second and a single shotgun shot does not.
now: Suppression now counts each round once, and one shotgun blast counts as one round.
